dataset: WorldPop Global1 constrained individual countries 2020 / BSGM / THA
attribution: WorldPop, University of Southampton. Bondarenko M., Kerr D., Sorichetta A. and Tatem A.J. (2020). Constrained BSGM census/projection-disaggregated population. Adapted by City Rating: district aggregation and density scoring.
method: Sum original float counts in pixel-center masks of published OSM district polygons, excluding holes; divide by official district area. NoData contributes zero; no pixel-area multiplier, reprojection or resampling of population counts.
